content.title: Document-shaped command line tools
content.lede: gowkhtmltopdf and gowkhtmltoimage use explicit source and output arguments while retaining familiar PDF and image options. Both write to the -o PATH given, or to stdout when the path is -.

content.heading: PDF grammar
content.code:
gowkhtmltopdf [GLOBAL OPTIONS] -o OUTPUT PAGE...
gowkhtmltopdf [GLOBAL OPTIONS] --html HTML -o OUTPUT
gowkhtmltopdf [GLOBAL OPTIONS] --url URL -o OUTPUT
gowkhtmltopdf [GLOBAL OPTIONS] --cover COVER --toc -o OUTPUT PAGE...

content.heading: Examples
content.code:
gowkhtmltopdf --allow-local-files -o report.pdf report.html gowkhtmltopdf --page-size A4 --orientation Landscape -o book.pdf chapter1.html chapter2.html gowkhtmltopdf --html '

Inline report

' -o inline.pdf gowkhtmltoimage --format png --width 1024 -o preview.png report.html gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-version 1.7 --allow-local-files -o report-1.7.pdf report.html gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-profile a3a-ua1 --allow-local-files -o report-a3a-ua1.pdf report.html gowkhtmltopdf --font-path ./fonts --use-system-fonts --allow-local-files -o report-cjk.pdf report.html gowkhtmltoimage --format jpg --quality 85 --width 800 -o preview.jpg report.html

content.title: The old object grammar is removed
content.body: Use --cover and --toc instead of page, cover, and toc object tokens. -o/--output is required, and --html, --url, and positional pages are mutually exclusive document sources. -o - writes raw bytes to stdout; there is no stdin HTML shorthand, so pass markup with --html.

content.heading: Common options
rows: Write the PDF or image; use - for stdout
Opt in to local page and subresource reads
Set the PDF file version; a version alone is not a PDF/A or PDF/UA claim
Opt-in PDF/A + PDF/UA profile (implies PDF 1.7 / 2.0); aliases such as ua1 and a4 are accepted
Add a font directory (repeatable) or use fonts installed on the host
gowkhtmltoimage output format and JPEG quality (1-100); --width and --height set the raster size
gowkhtmltoimage canvas controls: transparency, smart width, and crop rectangle
